authority.rule: Ponytail is a minimalism decision filter. It never overrides correctness, validation, security, accessibility, persistence safety or Atlas-specific guardrails.

principles.summary: Skip work that is not required by the requested outcome.
Reuse the current canonical implementation before creating another owner or parallel system.
Prefer the standard library, native platform features or an already-installed dependency before adding another dependency.
Use the smallest coherent implementation that fully solves the current problem.
Do not generalize for hypothetical future needs or add wrappers, factories or compatibility layers just in case.
Never trade away tests, diagnostics, data protection or project guardrails merely to shrink a diff.

dependency_manifest_change.title: Dependency manifest changed
dependency_manifest_change.recommendation: Confirm that the new or changed dependency is necessary and that an existing/native solution is not already sufficient.

low_fanin_abstraction.title: New abstraction has low static fan-in
low_fanin_abstraction.recommendation: Confirm that the abstraction has a real current consumer and is simpler than using the existing canonical owner directly.

parallel_path_marker.title: New path looks like a parallel or compatibility implementation
parallel_path_marker.recommendation: Confirm that this is not a second implementation kept just in case and that any compatibility layer has a real boundary and removal plan.

broad_diff.title: Change is broad enough to review scope explicitly
broad_diff.recommendation: Confirm that the changed files and added code are necessary for the requested outcome; split unrelated work into another lot.
